home.title: Let's Ship It
home.tagline: Floods hit the city. Four teams, one system. Get supplies to 1,200 families.
home.teamBody: Take turns: one of you plays each stage while the rest watch and help. 2–4 players.

replay.heading: Pick a stage
replay.intro: There's more! Replays add bonus levels you haven't seen yet. Replays aren't ranked.
replay.teaser: There's more! Replay any stage to unlock bonus levels.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.sound: Sound effects (short beeps for right and wrong)
settings.relaxed: Relaxed timers: 50% more time on every clock. In a team, this slows the player's timers too.
settings.teamRelaxed: A teammate has relaxed timers on, so your timers are relaxed too.

leaderboard.todayNote: Top 20 today. Resets at midnight Singapore time.

leaderboard.emptyAll: No teams yet. Be the first.
leaderboard.error: Can't reach the leaderboard. Your game still works.

components.handoffBody: {name}, it's your turn: {stage}. Tap I'm ready on your phone.
components.tutorialHint: Try it, or tap Got it.

prologue.heading: Mission: flood relief
prologue.body: Floods have hit the city. Your job: get supplies to as many of 1,200 families as you can, using data, AI, software and the cloud.

tips.text: Each stage has short, timed levels. Beat the clock.
Stuck? A hint appears after 2 misses, the answer after 3.
Every stage feeds the next. Good data makes a better AI.

app.loadError: That screen didn't load. Check the connection, then tap Reload.
